name: DRAGON
description: DRAGON is the first dynamic benchmark for evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems in Russian on a changing news corpus. It supports comprehensive evaluation of both retriever and generator components with automatically generated questions based on knowledge graphs, capturing the dynamic nature of real-world deployments.
reputation: A very recent niche benchmark from the RAG evaluation literature, with limited but growing visibility because it targets Russian dynamic news retrieval rather than a widely used general-purpose suite.
notes: Benchmark is dynamic and regularly updated; includes automatic question generation and evaluation scripts; focuses on Russian language news data.
